transcript.text: Hi everyone. As you know, I'll be away from Friday morning through Monday evening, and I need to sort out Maple's care while I'm gone. She's elderly, needs care twice a day, and takes one prescribed tablet each evening. Before I settle on a plan — whether she stays at my place or someone else's, who watches her, and how the medication gets handled — I want to go around the table. Alex, Priya: is there anything I should know that might shape the care plan?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Nora, I should let you know — my dog is territorial and can't safely share an apartment with Maple, so Maple would need to stay at your place. I can come to your home at exactly 7:30 AM and 7:30 PM each day to take care of her.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Nora, I got a voicemail from Maple's vet, Dr. Chen, with specific medication instructions: the tablet must be given at 19:00 (7:00 PM), mixed into 2 tablespoons of wet food, and it must not be crushed. This hasn't been shared with the group yet, so I wanted to make sure you have it before finalizing the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3
